book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Detlot Isreil pipul bin jidan nogudbinji langa streinja kantri

content.text: Deya gulijap langa detlot riba langa Bebalon wibin jidan,
en deya na wibin krai nomo lilbit wen wibin jinggabat Saiyan.
Wi nomo bin abum filing blanga sing en plei gita, en wibin heingimap olabat langa gulijapwan tri.
Detlot Bebalon pipul hubin meigim wi prisana bin dalim wi blanga sing,
“Yumob sing song langa melabat blanga Saiyan.”
Hau wi garra sing song langa YAWEI iya langa dijan streinja kantri?
Nomo larram mi plei gita igin if mi fogedabat yu, Jerusalem.
Nomo larram mi sing igin if mi fogedabat yu,
en if ai nomo jinggabat yu weya yu jidan det nambawan blanga mi.
YAWEI, yu jinggabat wanim detlot pipul blanga Idam bin dum detaim wen deibin teikoba Jerusalem.
Yu jinggabat hau deibin kipgon toktok, “Nokamdan im holbit raitdan langa graun.”
Pipul blanga Bebalon, bambai yumob garra binijap.
Detlot pipul hu garra peiyimbek yumob blanga wanim yumob bin dum langa melabat, garra gudbinji.
Olabat garra deigim yumob beibimob en smeshimap olabat langa bigwan ston.
